item.title: there's plenty of floor down here. pull up a spot. $duk

item.title: musical chairs. he doesn't need a chair. $duk

item.description: A 3x3 grid of photos fills in one by one, every one of them DUK in THE DUK pose. The middle photo is the only one still standing. Everyone else stares at him. He drops: grid complete. "post your duk."

item.title: the one thing he can't duk. $duk
item.description: DUK is lying flat in THE DUK pose, staring, totally safe. Then a robot vacuum comes buzzing along the floor straight at him. Ground level. Nowhere lower to go. Beep beep. He pops up, it rolls under where he was, he lands back down right behind it: "unduckable."

item.title: the liquidation cascade stopped at the floor. he lives there.
item.description: Wide shot. A row of white dominoes labelled "longs" stands next to DUK, who is already flat at the end of the line. Someone taps the first one; they fall one by one, and the last domino lands on top of him... and just lies there. He keeps staring. "cascade over." "he was already down there."

item.description: Green day. DUK stands there, almost relaxed. A phone pops up with a notification: "top is in." He reads it, and drops flat instantly, no questions. "he heard." Then a second notification: "jk." He does not move.

item.title: let's look at that again in slow motion.
item.description: Sports-style replay. "replay." A red candle drifts in at quarter speed while DUK lowers himself flat in slow motion. Freeze frame; yellow telestrator marks: circle on the wings "wings over head", arrow to the eyes "still staring", line under him "full contact with floor". "textbook."
